title: One stage of the launch contract, with its action, its checks and its recovery
description: One entry of `stages` of the launch contract (feature 107), written by the completion of the draft (F107-FR-041), one of kind `specstride` per feature. The record schema `launch-contract.schema.json` of @specstride/contracts gives the words of `action` and `recovery`; this item schema joins to it by reference so that one composed schema is the validator (T005). The kinds of a stage and the types of a check are ids of the registries of feature 123 (EP-19): the schema lists what is registered (the registries are open; membership is a rule of validation), and the timing of a check is a member of the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 282 (timingOfACheckOfALaunchContract of @specstride/contracts). The reasons of `recovery` are the stop reasons of the terminal record that allow a retry, transient members of annex E §E.3 (a rule of validation). The optional list `writes` is validated and unused: only parallel units and verification may read it (F107-FR-037).

id.description: The id of the stage; unique in the graph (a rule of validation)

kind.description: The kind of the stage: an id of the registry of stage kinds of feature 123 (EP-19); `specstride` for the one stage of a feature

depends_on.description: The ids of the stages this stage depends on (a rule of validation: the ordering has no cycle)

cwd.description: The working directory of the stage, relative to the repository root

action.description: The argument list the stage runs (T062: an argv, not an object)

resume.description: The argument list a resumed run of the stage passes

preconditions.description: The preconditions of the stage: checks of the registry of precondition checks of feature 123 (EP-19), each with its timing

postconditions.description: The postconditions of the stage: checks of the registry of precondition checks of feature 123 (EP-19), each with its timing

recovery.description: The recovery of the stage: the maximum of attempts, the exit codes to retry, the backoff, the total time limit, and the reason rule (the record schema of @specstride/contracts gives the words)

max_attempts.description: The maximum of attempts of the stage; the default 1

retry_exit_codes.description: The exit codes that retry the stage

backoff_seconds.description: The backoff in seconds between attempts

total_timeout_seconds.description: The total time limit in seconds of the attempts

reason.description: The stop reasons of the terminal record that allow a retry: transient members of annex E §E.3 (a rule of validation)

writes.description: The optional declared writes of the stage; validated and unused — only parallel units and verification may read it (F107-FR-037)

check.description: A check of the registry of precondition checks of feature 123 (EP-19), with its type, its fields and its timing

type.description: The id of the check in the registry (EP-19)

timing.description: The timing of the check; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 282 (timingOfACheckOfALaunchContract of @specstride/contracts)

check.description: The id of the check in the registry (EP-19); the port's member name for the record's `type`
